component.name: Astrill Lazy Router
component.summary: Direct and Astrill routing policy control

description.p: A native Ubuntu controller and DD-WRT companion for routing services, websites, devices, and isolated applications either directly or through the active Astrill tunnel.

Adds verified dynamic router-policy precedence, explicit Apply-all and multi-select Apply-selected capacity preflight, clearer local-versus-applied state, reboot-persistent Ubuntu application identities, and a bounded transient macOS UU media-socket route.
Compacts the Windows Endpoints workspace, moves manual PC latency into an on-demand dialog, and allows verified favorite changes to merge safely without discarding unrelated Connection drafts.

Adds the complete native Windows Connection workflow, durable endpoint and service multiselection, atomic bulk favorites, human-readable Astrill sections, and a lower-overhead companion with corrected policy precedence and connection timing.

Adds confirmed bidirectional native endpoint favorites with concurrent-change protection plus synchronized next-favorite reconnect and router-boot startup controls, without recurring polling or reconnecting Astrill.
Persists validated Windows PC endpoint-latency results and adds Default, Region, and numeric latency endpoint sorting without automatic tests or recurring router polling.
Adds sortable Country and Ping columns to the endpoint browser while keeping bounded desktop-path measurements behind the explicit Ping action.
Adds on-demand latency measurements for real Astrill endpoint addresses and updates secure remote noVNC launch targets.
Combines startup router state into one read-only SSH snapshot and runs deeper companion recovery checks only after detecting degraded state.
Adds a synchronized native Astrill connection view with validated endpoint, protocol, port, transport, favorite, and resilience controls plus recoverable reconnects.
Add native-only inspection, reversible native-policy overlays, configurable reboot-persistent noVNC, and secure macOS and Windows launchers.
Adds synchronized native Astrill settings, incremental policy semantics, route recommendations, complete minimum bypass profiles, and native-only restoration.
Adds country policy visibility, a distinct Astrill endpoint browser, complete LAN inventory sources, router operations, and Nutstore.
Adds 260 service profiles, catalog filters, desktop login startup, and automatic router companion reconciliation.
